data.name: Rukaayah
data.gender_notes: Rukaayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukaayah is derived from the Arabic word 'rukaa' which means 'to elevate or make lofty'. It symbolizes growth and reaching new heights. The name Rukaayah carries the meaning “Elevated, Lofty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rukaayah usually hope their child will grow to embody elevated, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies spiritual upliftment and growth.
data.etymology: Rukaayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elevated, Lofty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukaayah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: روكاية
in_arabic.meaning: روكاية تعني الحماية من الله تعالى ورعايته للإنسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم روكاية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ك-ي' والذي يعني الحماية والرعاية. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الحماية الإلهية والرعاية الربانية للإنسان. استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية كدلالة على الثقة بالله وحمايته.

in_urdu.name: روکیہ
in_urdu.meaning: روکیہ کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالی کی حفاظت اور نگہداشت
in_urdu.long_meaning: روکیہ نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ك-ي' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت اور نگہداشت. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں الہی حفاظت اور نگہداشت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں اس کا خاص اہمیت ہے.

in_hindi.name: रुकाया
in_hindi.meaning: रुकाया का अर्थ है अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और देखभाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुकाया नाम अरबी जड़ 'र-ك-ي' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा और देखभाल. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में ईश्वरीय सुरक्षा और देखभाल के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: روكايه
in_pashto.meaning: روكايه د الهي حفاظت او پاملنې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: روكايه نوم د عربي جذر 'ر-ك-ي' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې د حفاظت او پاملنې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دود کې د الهي حفاظت او پاملنې د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Rukaayah
in_english.meaning: Rukaayah means protection and care from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rukaayah is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ك-ي' (r-k-y), which signifies protection, care, and guardianship. In Islamic tradition, Rukaayah symbolizes divine protection and care. Historically, this name has been used across Muslim cultures to signify trust in Allah's safeguarding. It connotes a sense of spiritual security and divine oversight.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rukaayah holds a significant impact on Islamic culture as it embodies the concept of progression, growth, and striving for betterment. In the Islamic tradition, names are often associated with character traits, stories, or moral values. Rukaayah resonates deeply with the Islamic belief of constantly moving forward in life, whether that be in one's career, education, or personal development.
data.spiritual_significance: Rukaayah symbolizes spiritual aspiration and yearning for the divine. The name derives from ‘ruka’ which can also mean to yearn or long for something. Thus, it invokes the notion of seeking nearness to Allah (swt) and striving towards higher spiritual realms. Additionally, the root 'ruk' can be found in 'Rukun', one of the Five Pillars of Islam, which means 'to establish and maintain' – a regular reminder of upholding one's faith and maintaining a strong connection with God.

It symbolizes growth and reaching new heights.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rukaayah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of elevated, lofty.

historical_references.reference: Born in Mecca in 614 AD, Rukaayah was the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) cousin, Umar ibn Al-Khattab. She was married to Zaid ibn Harithah, who was the first husband of the Prophet's (pbuh) beloved wife, Aisha.
historical_references.context: Rukaayah is known for being the first wife of Zaid ibn Harithah, who later married Aisha, the Prophet's (pbuh) favorite wife.
